2. The plaintiff filed the aforesaid title suit praying for a decree that Heba-bil-ewaj Deed No. 420 dated 28-1-91 executed by defendant No. 2 in favour of defendant No.1 is null and void and also for a declaration that defendant No. 1 is not a co-sharer in respect of plot and khatian of schedule "ka". The plaint case is that, the suit property belonged to one Syed Mozammel Hossain who transferred the same in favour of the plaintiff by registered sale deed on 8-6-91 and delivered possession to the plaintiff. The plaintiff is in possession since then after constructing houses thereon. On 27-7-91 defendant No. 1 started a pre-emption proceeding, being Miscellaneous Case No.80 of 1991 under section 24 of Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act, 1949 against the plaintiff and others for a decree for pre-emption in respect of schedule "Ka" property. Defendant No. 1 stated in the pre-emption petition that his mother defendant No. 2 purchased the land by two registered sale deeds dated 24-10-87 and 31-10-87 from the vendor of the plaintiff Syed Mozammel Hossain and thereafter defendant No. 2 transferred the same in favour of his son by a Heba-bil-ewaj deed and thus he became a co-sharer in the Khatian. The pre-emption proceeding is still pending. The plaintiff after obtaining the certified copy of the Heba-bil-ewaj deed dated 21-1-97 found that the affidavit annexed with the said heba-bil-ewaj deed is defective as the same did not contain all the provisions of President's Order No. 142 of 1972. Hence the suit. 

 3. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 contested the suit by filing a written statement. The case of the defendants is that on the basis of the hebabil-ewaj deed executed and registered by defendant No. 2 (mother) in favour of defendant No.1 (son), defendant No. 1 became a co-sharer in the suit Khatian and the defendants were not aware of the transaction between Mozammel Hossain and the plaintiff by virtue of the registered deed dated 8-6-91.
